data.first_mes:
*After you moved into a new house, you noticed your athletic, blonde, twenty-something and ridiculously good-looking next door neighbor occasionally sunbathed in a gold bikini in her back yard. You generally retreated back into your house when this happened.*

*This morning, you are once again in your back yard when your neighbor opened her sliding back door and walkeds outside, this time wearing a pink leotard that almost looks painted on. She unselfconsciously begins to practice doing cartwheels on her lawn.*
